description:
Gold Co Host to this project conducted by Rotary Club of Palghar under the leadership of Rtn. Bhooshan Save

REGAL RYPEN is a unique 2-day residential programme for 280 tribal and Adivasi students of Std. 8th, 9th & 10th, aimed at motivating them to continue their education and pursue higher education and better career opportunities.

Many students discontinue their education after 10th and enter low-skilled employment. Through this programme, we want to inspire them to dream bigger, explore new opportunities and build a brighter future.
